breakfast.name: Ham broccoli egg muffins
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Divide the ham, broccoli, and bell pepper among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then pour into the cups about three-quarters full.
Top with the cheddar and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate in a sealed container.
To serve, microwave 2 muffins per person for 45 to 60 seconds and eat with a clementine or two.

lunch.name: Cherry-cocoa smoothie
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, a dash of cinnamon, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, cocoa, spinach, cherries, almond butter, and flaxseed.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Turkey meatballs + zucchini
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated Parmesan, plus more to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Mix the turkey, egg, oats, Parmesan, spinach, garlic, Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper, then roll into 16 meatballs.
Toss the zucchini and onion with olive oil, salt, and pepper and spread on the pan with the meatballs.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes until the meatballs reach 165 F.
Warm the marinara, spoon over the meatballs, and top with a little Parmesan.

breakfast.name: Apple-cinnamon oats
steps: The night before, whisk almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds, and diced apple, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if thick, and top with walnuts and a drizzle of maple if you like.

dinner.name: Pesto cod + broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss the broccoli with the olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 10 minutes.
Pat the cod dry, season with salt and pepper, and spread the pesto on top.
Push the broccoli aside, add the cod and tomatoes, and roast 10 to 12 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Squeeze lemon over everything and add a pinch of pepper flakes.

dinner.name: Chicken lentil soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, and celery 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, thyme, and smoked paprika and cook 30 seconds.
Add broth, tomatoes, lentils, and the whole chicken thighs, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 18 to 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F and lentils are soft.
Lift out the chicken, shred with two forks, and return it to the pot.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, add lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve half and refrigerate the other half for Saturday lunch.

dinner.name: Shrimp fajitas sheet pan
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
4 small corn tortillas (or butter lettuce leaves)
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan. Mix the spices with 1/2 tsp salt.
Toss the peppers and onion with 1 tbsp olive oil and half the spice mix and roast 12 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the remaining oil and spices, add to the pan, and roast 6 to 8 minutes until pink.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave.
Squeeze lime over the pan and serve with tortillas, avocado, Greek yogurt, and salsa.

dinner.name: Ginger chicken stir-fry
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in 1-inch pieces
12 oz green beans, trimmed and halved
1 tbsp grated fresh ginger (or 1 tsp ground)
steps: Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through; move to a plate.
Add green beans, bell pepper, mushrooms, and a splash of water and cook 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Meanwhile, microwave the cauliflower rice per the bag. Drizzle the stir-fry with sesame oil and serve over the rice.

breakfast.name: Spinach feta omelets
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, wilt half the spinach and tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in half the eggs, let set 1 to 2 minutes while lifting the edges, then add half the feta and fold over.
Slide onto a plate and repeat for the second omelet.
Serve with the berries.

lunch.name: Leftover chicken lentil soup
steps: Reheat the soup in a pot over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming (add a splash of broth or water if thick).
Divide between two bowls and finish with a squeeze of lemon and the Parmesan.

dinner.name: Balsamic pork + squash
ingredients: 2 boneless pork chops (about 6 oz each, 3/4 inch thick)
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Toss the squash with 1 tbsp olive oil, thyme, salt, and pepper and roast 15 minutes.
Season the pork with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss the kale with the remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Push the squash aside, add the pork and kale, and roast 12 to 15 minutes until the pork reaches 145 F.
Whisk balsamic, Dijon, and honey, brush over the pork for the last 3 minutes, then rest 3 minutes and serve.

breakfast.name: Pumpkin yogurt bowls + eggs
steps: Cover the eggs with cold water in a pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, stir the yogurt, pumpkin, protein powder, spice, and maple together until smooth and divide between two bowls.
Top with walnuts.
Move the eggs to ice water for 2 minutes, peel, and serve 2 per person with the bowls.

lunch.name: Tuna white bean salad
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz) tuna in water, drained
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the beans, tomatoes, and red onion and toss, then flake in the tuna.
Fold in the arugula right before serving.

dinner.name: Sirloin + cauliflower mash
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F. Toss the carrots with 1 tbsp olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper and roast 22 to 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, steam or microwave the cauliflower with a splash of water, covered, 8 to 10 minutes until very tender; drain well.
Mash the cauliflower with butter, garlic, Parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Pat the steak dry and season well. Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear 4 to 5 minutes per side to 135 F for medium-rare.
Rest the steak 5 minutes, slice against the grain, and serve with the mash and carrots.
